szoveg_eredeti:
Introducing the Perplexity Orchestrator API.

Orchestrator lets you choose the right model for the right task, and automatically selects the provider based on availability, capacity, and latency.

It serves 45+ models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and xAI, as well as open-weight models, in one API with unified billing.

If a request fails, Orchestrator can retry on another deployment of the same model.

You can connect an existing OpenAI or Anthropic SDK to a Perplexity API, key and all models can be called with OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages.

Orchestrator also offers automatic routing, available in preview. It picks a model per request using profiles that map plain-language tasks to models, then uses a decision model to match the conversation to the right route.

Orchestrator is built on Perplexity's model layer, which runs in production every day, intelligently routing hundreds of millions of requests across 85+ models and more than a dozen providers.

Now developers can build on the same infrastructure.

Each model is billed at its published per-token rate, whichever provider serves it.

Track spend by model, project, and API key in the API Console, and set model allowlists and spend caps.

Read more: https://lnkd.in/gxC_jMjM
